classes.tooltip:
Receives mavros_msgs/msg/AttitudeTarget on /<namespace>/cmd_attitude and forwards it to an
IUBotAttitudeCommandable target (an aerial vehicle, such as a drone with a uBot Multirotor Dynamics component).

- type_mask without IGNORE_ATTITUDE (128): an attitude command; the orientation is converted from the ROS world
  frame to UE and body_rate is not used.
- type_mask with IGNORE_ATTITUDE: a body-rate command from body_rate (FLU -> UE body); axes with
  IGNORE_ROLL_RATE (1), IGNORE_PITCH_RATE (2) or IGNORE_YAW_RATE (4) are 0.
- thrust (0..1 of the vehicle's maximum) is used unless IGNORE_THRUST (64) is set; then the vehicle holds its
  altitude.

The bridge needs the mavros_msgs package (ros-humble-mavros-msgs).

One TCP connection per game/PIE world to the ROS-side ubot_ros_bridge node (wire protocol v1,
docs/PROTOCOL.md). Socket I/O runs on a background thread; the game thread never blocks on the
socket. Received messages are dispatched to subscription callbacks on the game thread during Tick.

Outgoing queue policy: a best_effort publisher keeps only its newest pending message (older ones
are counted as dropped) and drops data while no session is active; reliable messages are queued in
order, also while the bridge is reconnecting, up to MaxQueuedBytes (then the oldest pending
best_effort data is evicted first, then new reliable data is rejected with a warning). While the
bridge is Disabled nothing is queued. Advertisements and subscriptions persist across reconnects
and are re-sent (with the same ids) after every HELLO.

All methods are game thread only.

Base of the components that receive commands from ROS 2 through the uBot ROS bridge and forward them to a
target that implements a uBotCore actuation interface. Contains no control logic.

- Topic: /<namespace>/<leaf of the subclass> (best_effort / volatile / depth 10). The namespace comes from
  UBot::Identity unless Robot Namespace Override is set; Command Topic Override replaces the whole topic.
- Target: Target Component when set, else the owner actor or its first component that implements the
  subclass' interface. Without a target the component still decodes commands, fires its events and runs
  the timeout.
- Timeout: when no command arrived for Command Timeout Seconds of sim time, the target is released exactly
  once (it falls back to its own behavior, such as a hover) and On Command Timeout fires. Ending play
  releases an active command too.

properties.tooltip: Sim seconds without a command before the target is released. 0 disables the timeout.
Non-empty -> used instead of /<namespace>/<leaf>. A missing leading '/' is added.

Empty -> the namespace resolved by UBot::Identity (identity component, else the sanitized actor name).
Leading/trailing '/' are ignored and every segment is sanitized; a value made only of '/' selects the
root namespace.

Component that receives the commands; it must implement the subclass' interface. Unset -> the owner actor
or its first implementing component. With only "Referenced Actor" set, that actor is searched the same way.
Subscribe in BeginPlay. When false, call Restart Command Receiver to start receiving.

classes.tooltip:
Blueprint access to the ROS-specific conventions in UBot::ROSConventions: camera optical frame,
builtin_interfaces/Time fields and ROS names. The UE <-> right-handed axis mapping ROS uses is in
uBotCore (category uBot|Conventions, nodes "UE To Right-Handed ...").

Receives actuator_msgs/msg/Actuators on /<namespace>/cmd_motors and forwards it to an IUBotMotorCommandable
target (for example a drone's uBot Multirotor Dynamics component). velocity[] (rad/s) is used when it has
values, else normalized[] (0..1); position[] is ignored. A command whose length differs from the target's
motor count is not dispatched.

The bridge needs the actuator_msgs package (ros-humble-actuator-msgs).

Publishes every uBot sensor of its owner actor to ROS 2 through the uBot ROS bridge subsystem
(successor of the legacy AgentROSSensorSuitePublisher; same Blueprint API, events, status values
and validation rules).

Discovery: UBot::Sensors::FindSensors(Owner) (the owner itself and its components; child actors are
not searched). For each sensor the supporting IUBotROSSensorPublisherFactory with the highest priority
creates a publisher; sensors no factory supports are skipped.

Identity: namespace = RobotNamespaceOverride ("/" = root namespace), else UBot::Identity::ResolveNamespace(Owner); base frame
= BaseFrameOverride, else UBot::Identity::ResolveBaseFrameId(Owner); base component = BaseLinkComponent,
else UBot::Identity::ResolveBaseComponent(Owner). With bPrefixFramesWithNamespace every frame the
bridge publishes (except the world frame of world-referenced poses) becomes "<namespace>/<frame>".

Topics: "/<namespace>/<default path>" (pose, odom, imu/data, scan, lidar/points,
camera/color/image_raw + camera_info, camera/depth/image_raw + camera_info; "<SensorId>/..." when several
sensors share a type) unless TopicOverrides has an enabled entry for the logical key (pose, odom, imu,
scan, lidar, rgb_camera, rgb_camera.camera_info, depth_camera, depth_camera.camera_info; for several
sensors of a type the sanitized SensorId and "<SensorId>.camera_info"). Overrides without a leading '/'
get one. Invalid topics, topics assigned twice, empty sensor ids or frame ids, duplicate sensor ids
within a type and duplicate sensor frame ids put the component into the Error state.

TF: static base -> sensor (from IUBotSensor::GetSensorFrameComponent relative to the base component)
and sensor -> "<frame>_optical" for optical publishers through the subsystem's /tf_static aggregation;
dynamic odom -> base from the first odometry sensor whose tracked component is the base component and
whose frames match OdometryFrame / the base frame. The odometry sensor gets no static transform (its
FrameId is the odometry frame, which is the parent of the base frame), and neither does any other
sensor whose frame equals the odometry frame.

The component becomes Ready once its publishers are set up; it does not wait for the bridge
connection (data is dropped or queued per QoS meanwhile) and logs one Warning per disconnected period.

properties.tooltip: Empty -> base frame of the owner's uBot identity (default "base_link").
Empty or unresolved -> base component of the owner's uBot identity (default: root component).

Blank -> namespace of the owner's uBot identity (UBot::Identity::ResolveNamespace); "/" alone -> root
namespace (topics like "/imu/data"). '/' separates nested namespaces; every segment is sanitized.
Overrides the sensor data QoS (default best_effort / volatile / 5).
Overrides the state QoS of pose and odometry (default reliable / volatile / 10).

Optional overrides keyed by logical topic name: pose, odom, imu, scan, lidar, rgb_camera, rgb_camera.camera_info, depth_camera, depth_camera.camera_info; for several sensors of one type the sanitized SensorId and <SensorId>.camera_info.
Publish frames as "<namespace>/<frame>" (multi-robot TF trees).
Skip encoding (and camera readback) while the bridge reports no subscriber for a topic.

classes.tooltip:
Project settings for uBot ROS (Project Settings > Plugins > uBot ROS), stored in the project's
Config/DefaultUBotROS.ini, section [/Script/UBotROS.UBotROSSettings], where uBot Manager edits
BridgeHost and BridgePort too. Read when a world's bridge subsystem connects; changes apply on the
next Connect().

properties.tooltip: Host of the ubot_ros_bridge node (name or IP address). IPv4 results are preferred.
TCP port of the ubot_ros_bridge node.
Absolute topic of the clock publisher.
Largest frame payload accepted from the bridge or sent to it (protocol default 64 MiB).

Budget for frames waiting to be sent (and for received messages waiting for dispatch). When
exceeded, the oldest pending best_effort messages are dropped first, then new reliable
messages are rejected with a warning. A value below MaxPayloadBytes + 12 (one maximum frame) is
raised to that when connecting (with a warning): otherwise large messages could never fit.
Delay between connection attempts while the bridge is unreachable or after the connection is lost.
Connect automatically when a game or PIE world begins play.
Publish rosgraph_msgs/msg/Clock with the uBot sim time every world tick while connected.

classes.tooltip:
Receives geometry_msgs/msg/Twist velocity commands from ROS 2 through the uBot ROS bridge and forwards
them to an IUBotVelocityCommandable target. Contains no control logic.

- Topic: /<namespace>/cmd_vel (best_effort / volatile / depth 10). The namespace comes from UBot::Identity
  unless RobotNamespaceOverride is set; CommandTopicOverride replaces the whole topic.
- Conversion: ROS body frame -> UE body axes through UBot::ROSConvert::MakeVelocityCommand (linear (x, -y, z),
  angular (-x, y, -z), Source "ROS", timestamp = uBot sim time at reception), then the optional speed limits.
- Target: TargetComponent when set, else UBot::Actuation::FindVelocityCommandable(owner). Without a target the
  component still decodes commands, fires its events and runs the timeout, so Blueprints can consume them.
- Timeout: when no command arrived for CommandTimeoutSeconds of sim time (checked in TickComponent, which only
  runs while a command is active), the target receives StopMotion exactly once and OnCommandTimeout fires.

properties.tooltip: Sim seconds without a command before the target is stopped. 0 disables the timeout.
Non-empty -> used instead of /<namespace>/cmd_vel. A missing leading '/' is added.

properties.displayName: Max Angular Speed Radians Per Second
properties.tooltip: Upper bound of the angular speed (vector norm, axis preserved). 0 = unlimited.

properties.displayName: Max Linear Speed Meters Per Second
properties.tooltip: Upper bound of the linear speed (vector norm, direction preserved). 0 = unlimited.

Empty -> the namespace resolved by UBot::Identity (identity component, else the sanitized actor name).
Leading/trailing '/' are ignored and every segment is sanitized; a value made only of '/' selects the
root namespace (topic /cmd_vel).

Component that receives the commands; it must implement IUBotVelocityCommandable. Unset -> the owner actor
or its first implementing component. With only "Referenced Actor" set, that actor is searched the same way.
Subscribe in BeginPlay. When false, call RestartCommandReceiver to start receiving.

Disabled: not connecting (Disconnect() called, or auto-connect off and Connect() not called).

Error: the last attempt failed or the connection was lost; retrying every ReconnectIntervalSeconds.
